name: Patel
pattern: Emotional manipulation in private messages. When a member said they were leaving a chat because they were tired, the response was to make that choice about Patel's own feelings, demand the member take accountability for it, and turn hostile when the member declined to keep talking.
advice: You do not owe anyone an explanation for leaving a chat or stepping back. If a conversation turns into this, you can stop replying and, if you want, forward it to a member of staff.
